referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This process includes the collection of waste vegetable oil and delivery to the treatment plant, treatment for impurities and water removal, conditioning and storage of the oil. Treatment of effluents is taken into account. Includes also the gross calorific value of the biomass and the carbon dioxide credit. System boundary is at the oil refining facility.
